protocol.support: frozen project manifest (same support sets as every other compared method)
upstream_quirks_reproduced: images are resized to 1024x1024 before the model transform
support images are converted BGR->RGB, query images are not
protocol.dumped_map: per-image 240x240 score map after the method's own scale fusion and bilinear upsampling
protocol.rect: whole original image, [0,1]x[0,1]: transforms.Resize((240,240)) stretches the image to a square and CenterCrop(240) is then a no-op
